What changes from level to level每升一级换了什么

  • 5–6 → 7–8 I can finish the work on Friday → What I can do is complete my part by Friday afternoon Task Fulfillment完成任务
    The upgrade turns a flat offer into a polite, structured suggestion with a clear deadline, which fulfils the task of proposing another solution more convincingly.升级后的表达把生硬的提议变成了礼貌、有结构且带明确时限的建议，更好地完成了“提出另一种解决办法”的任务要求。
  • 7–8 → 9+ hearing me out → Thank you for taking the time to listen Vocabulary词汇
    The upgrade replaces a simple thank-you with a more formal, complete phrase that shows respect for the manager’s time, which suits a workplace conversation.升级后的说法用更正式、完整的短语取代了简单的感谢，体现出对经理时间的尊重，更适合职场沟通。
  • 5–6 → 7–8 I hope you understand → I’d really appreciate your understanding Listenability好懂程度
    Softening the request with a hedge and a specific verb sounds more tactful and is easier to follow than a bare hope, so the tone stays firm but polite.用委婉语和更具体的动词来缓和请求，比单纯的“希望”更得体，也更容易听懂，使语气保持坚定而礼貌。
Notes on this prompt这道题的讲解
  • When declining a request from a superior, Chinese speakers often say they cannot, but in English I’m afraid I won’t be able to is more polite while keeping your position clear.向上级拒绝要求时，中文常说“我不能”，英文里用 I’m afraid I won’t be able to 更礼貌，同时立场依然明确。
  • A firm but polite structure usually goes: show understanding first, then explain your situation, and finally offer an alternative, which avoids offence and still fulfils the task.坚定而礼貌的结构通常是：先认同对方，再说明自己的情况，最后提出替代方案，这样既不冒犯人，又能完成任务要求。

What changes from level to level每升一级换了什么

  • 5–6 → 7–8 It is hard to get another one. → Rescheduling it would mean waiting a very long time for a new slot Content / Coherence内容与连贯
    Instead of simply saying it is hard, the better version explains the real consequence of changing the appointment, which makes your reason more convincing.不只说“很难”，而是说明改期的实际后果，让理由更有说服力。
  • 7–8 → 9+ I hope you can understand my situation → I trust you will see why this matters to me Listenability好懂程度
    A confident, relationship-focused closing sounds more natural and respectful than a simple hope, and it keeps the tone firm but polite.用带有信任感的结尾，比单纯的“希望”更自然、更尊重对方，同时保持坚定而礼貌的语气。
  • 5–6 → 7–8 I will finish my work before Thursday. → To make sure nothing falls behind, I will finish my part before Thursday Task Fulfillment完成任务
    Linking your promise to a purpose, so that nothing falls behind, makes the solution clearer and fulfils the task of suggesting a way to solve the problem.把承诺和目的（确保工作不被耽误）联系起来，让解决办法更清楚，也更好地完成了“提出解决办法”的任务要求。
Notes on this prompt这道题的讲解
  • When you refuse politely, I am afraid I cannot sounds softer than I cannot. Here the word afraid does not mean scared. It means regretfully.委婉拒绝时，I am afraid I cannot 比 I cannot 更礼貌；afraid 在这里不是“害怕”，而是表示“遗憾地”。
  • For a doctor visit, use the word appointment, not reservation. Reservation is normally used for restaurants or hotels.说“预约”医生时用 appointment，不要用 reservation；reservation 一般用于餐厅或酒店。

Prompt题目 33 How institutions work制度怎么运转

You are attending a residents' committee meeting. One member suggests that everyone should send repair complaints directly to the building manager through private text messages. You believe this approach is unreliable and unfair because requests may be overlooked and other residents cannot follow their progress. Explain your concerns firmly but politely, propose a better procedure, and respond to the other member's suggestion respectfully. 你正在参加一次居民委员会会议。一位成员建议大家通过私人短信直接向楼宇经理发送维修投诉。你认为这种方式不够可靠，也不够公平，因为请求可能被遗漏，其他居民也无法了解处理进度。请坚定而有礼貌地解释你的顾虑，提出更好的处理程序，并尊重地回应这位成员的建议。

Plan: three points to cover提纲：要讲的三点
  1. Acknowledge why direct messages might seem convenient, but explain their limitations.承认直接发送短信可能比较方便，但解释这种方式的局限性。
  2. Recommend a shared reporting channel, a request log, and regular progress updates.建议建立共同的反馈渠道、请求登记记录和定期进度更新机制。
  3. Explain how your proposal balances efficiency, transparency, and accountability.解释你的建议如何兼顾效率、透明度和责任落实。

CELPIP 9+ · ≈C1 136 words词

During a residents' committee meeting, we had to decide how to handle repair complaints. One member advocated texting the building manager directly, arguing that it was the quickest option. I acknowledged the appeal of that approach, then explained why I could not support it as the main procedure. Private messages are easy to miss, difficult for others to track, and leave residents unsure whether an issue is being addressed. I stressed that a sound process should create a visible record and apply consistently to everyone. I proposed a shared reporting channel, a log showing the status of each request, and routine progress updates. I made clear that emergencies could still be reported to the manager immediately. By separating urgent communication from ordinary follow-up, we preserved speed without sacrificing accountability. The committee agreed to pilot the approach.

What changes from level to level每升一级换了什么

  • 5–6 → 7–8 messages could be missed → individual messages could easily be overlooked Vocabulary词汇
    The upgraded wording uses a more precise verb to describe how complaints may disappear from an informal communication process. It sounds more professional and makes the concern clearer.升级后的表达使用了更加准确的动词来描述投诉可能在非正式沟通流程中被遗漏的情况。这样的说法更加专业，也让提出的顾虑更加清晰。
  • 7–8 → 9+ try the shared system → pilot the approach Task Fulfillment完成任务
    The final version presents the decision as a structured trial rather than a general agreement to use something. This gives the response a more realistic institutional context and shows awareness that procedures can be evaluated and improved.最高级版本将决定描述为一次有组织的试行，而不是笼统地同意使用某种方式。这使回答更符合真实的机构管理场景，也体现了对流程可以评估和改进这一点的理解。
  • 5–6 → 7–8 other residents would not know what was happening → residents would have no shared record of what had been reported Content / Coherence内容与连贯
    The revised wording explains the practical consequence of having no shared record. It moves beyond saying that residents lack information and identifies the specific weakness in institutional transparency.修改后的表达具体说明了缺少共同记录会造成什么实际后果。它不再只是说居民不了解情况，而是指出了制度透明度方面的具体缺陷。
Notes on this prompt这道题的讲解
  • Both disagree and challenge can express different opinions, but in a formal discussion, I understand your point, but... is a more diplomatic expression. It acknowledges the other person's position before introducing a disagreement.disagree 和 challenge 都可以表达不同意见，但在正式讨论中，I understand your point, but... 是一种更委婉的表达方式，既承认对方观点，也为提出反对意见做好铺垫。
  • Transparent emphasizes that information and procedures are visible to relevant people, while accountable emphasizes that responsibilities can be traced and explained. Both words are frequently used when discussing institutional management.transparent 强调信息和流程对相关人员公开；accountable 强调责任能够被追踪和解释。两者经常一起用于讨论机构管理。
  • As a verb, pilot means to test a proposed approach on a trial basis, as in pilot a new system. It is more suitable than simply saying try a system in formal organizational and project-management contexts.pilot 作动词时表示试行某个方案，例如 pilot a new system。它比直接说 try a system 更适合正式的机构和项目管理语境。

Prompt题目 34 Investing and risk投资与风险

A relative asks you to put money into a risky investment plan that you are not comfortable with. Explain firmly but politely why you cannot join. 一位亲戚请你把钱投入一个你不放心的高风险投资计划。请坚定而礼貌地解释你为什么不能参与。

Plan: three points to cover提纲：要讲的三点
  1. Thank the person and show you understand their excitement.先感谢对方，并表示理解对方的热情。
  2. Say clearly that you cannot join and explain the risk concern.明确表示你不能参与，并说明你对风险的顾虑。
  3. Suggest a helpful next step and protect the relationship.提出有帮助的下一步建议，并维护好关系。

  • fall /fɔːl/ 跌倒；摔跤
    However, a price that has risen quickly can fall just as quickly. Should I Bet It All?
  • tend to /ˈtend tə/ 往往；倾向于
    While diversification will not protect you from every fall, it tends to soften the blow. Should I Bet It All?
  • time horizon /ˈtaɪm həˌraɪzn/ 投资期限；时间跨度
    The point is to take risks that you understand, in amounts that you can bear, over a time horizon that gives you room to recover. Beware the Sure Thing

green绿色 = new compared with the level below＝比下一级新加的说法 · dashed虚线 = what the next level replaces＝下一级要换掉的说法 · underlined下划线 = a point taught on this site (tap to open it)＝本站教过的知识点（点开去学）

What changes from level to level每升一级换了什么

  • 5–6 → 7–8 I cannot put my money in it → I am afraid I have to decline Listenability好懂程度
    The upgraded phrase is softer and more polite, and it sounds more natural than a blunt statement. It refuses clearly while keeping a respectful tone.升级后的说法更委婉、更礼貌，也比直白的陈述更自然，既明确拒绝，又保持了尊重的语气。
  • 7–8 → 9+ I hope this decision does not change that → I would hate for this to put any strain on us Vocabulary词汇
    The final phrase uses an idiomatic expression to protect the relationship. It sounds warmer and more sincere than a plain hope.最后这个说法用地道的表达来维护关系，比简单的“希望”听起来更温暖、更真诚。
  • 5–6 → 7–8 The risk is too high for me, and I need my savings for my family → the level of risk simply does not suit my situation, since my savings are set aside for my family Content / Coherence内容与连贯
    The upgrade gives a fuller and more convincing reason. It links the level of risk to the speaker’s real situation, so the refusal feels fair instead of sudden.升级后的说法给出了更完整、更有说服力的理由，把风险水平和说话者的实际情况联系起来，使拒绝显得合理而不突兀。
Notes on this prompt这道题的讲解
  • When refusing politely, thank the person first, then state your position, and finally offer a suggestion. This order is firm without hurting feelings.委婉拒绝时，先表达感谢，再说明立场，最后给出建议，这样的顺序既坚定又不伤感情。
  • A direct Chinese phrase meaning I do not want to can sound blunt when translated word for word. In English, I am afraid I have to or I would rather not sounds softer.中文里的“我不想”听起来可能很直接，英文里用 “I am afraid I have to” 或 “I would rather not” 会更柔和。
  • When you give reasons, base them on your own situation instead of criticising the other person’s idea. The other person will find it easier to accept.说明理由时，尽量把原因落在自己的情况上，而不是批评对方的想法，这样对方更容易接受。

Prompt题目 35 Law and justice法律与正义

Imagine that a close friend asks you to tell a court that you saw an accident that you did not actually see, in order to help his case. Explain to him, firmly but politely, why you cannot do this, and suggest a better way forward. 假设一位好朋友请你向法庭作证，说你看到了一起你其实没有看到的事故，以帮助他的案子。请坚定而礼貌地向他解释你为什么不能这样做，并提出更好的办法。

Plan: three points to cover提纲：要讲的三点
  1. Show that you care about him but state clearly that you cannot lie.表达你在乎他，但明确说明你不能说谎。
  2. Explain the serious consequences for both of you.解释这会给你们两人带来的严重后果。
  3. Offer an honest alternative, such as seeing a lawyer together.提出诚实的替代方案，例如一起去见律师。

  • likely to /ˈlaɪkli tə/ 可能会
    People who understand basic procedures are more likely to recognize when their rights have been violated and where to seek help. Justice Should Not Depend on Wealth
  • tend to /ˈtend tə/ 往往；倾向于

  • tends to /tendz tuː/ 往往会；倾向于

What changes from level to level每升一级换了什么

Notes on this prompt这道题的讲解
  • When refusing someone, first show understanding and care, then use the word but to state your limit. This is a common polite and firm structure.拒绝别人时，先表达理解和关心，再用 but 引出你的底线，这是礼貌而坚定的常用结构。

Notes on this prompt这道题的讲解
  • Being polite does not mean being weak. Structures such as would be grateful if and I am happy for you to ... provided let you state your position while staying courteous, which is the key to scoring well in this kind of task.委婉不等于软弱。用 would be grateful if、I am happy for you to ... provided 这类结构，可以在表明立场的同时保持礼貌，这是 Task 6 的得分关键。
  • Thanking first, then stating your need, then offering a concrete solution gives your answer a clear structure and makes it sound natural.先感谢、再说需求、最后给出具体办法，这个三步结构能让你的回答条理清楚，听起来也更自然。

Prompt题目 37 Language, thought and culture语言、思维与文化

You are working with a colleague on a community survey about language and cultural experiences. Your colleague wants to simplify several questions without consulting the rest of the team. You are concerned that this could change their meaning for people from different cultural backgrounds. Explain your concerns firmly but politely, suggest a better approach, and explain why everyone's perspective should be considered. 你正在与一位同事合作设计一份关于语言和文化经历的社区调查问卷。你的同事希望在没有征求团队其他成员意见的情况下，简化其中几个问题。你担心这可能改变不同文化背景的人对这些问题的理解。请坚定但礼貌地表达你的担忧，提出更好的处理方式，并解释为什么应该考虑每个人的观点。

Plan: three points to cover提纲：要讲的三点
  1. Politely introduce your disagreement and explain why the proposed changes concern you.礼貌地表达不同意见，并解释为什么你对拟议的修改感到担忧。

  3. Emphasize the importance of shared decisions and offer to help with the revision process.强调共同决策的重要性，并表示愿意协助修改工作。

I want to be clear about why I cannot support revising our community survey without consulting the group first. What changes from level to level每升一级换了什么

  • 5–6 → 7–8 Some questions may sound unclear to people from different backgrounds → Some questions may be interpreted differently by people from different cultural backgrounds Content / Coherence内容与连贯
    The upgraded version identifies the actual communication risk more precisely. It explains that cultural backgrounds can influence interpretation, rather than suggesting that the questions are simply difficult to understand.升级后的版本更准确地指出了沟通风险，解释文化背景会影响理解方式，而不是简单地认为这些问题本身难以理解。
  • 7–8 → 9+ have one person make the decision independently → the final wording should reflect a shared decision, not an individual's assumptions about how everyone will interpret the questions Task Fulfillment完成任务
    The advanced version presents the disagreement as a matter of shared responsibility and fair representation. It ends with a clear principle that reinforces the speaker's position without becoming aggressive.高级版本将分歧提升为共同责任和公平表达的问题，并以明确的原则收尾，在不显得咄咄逼人的情况下坚定地表达立场。
  • 5–6 → 7–8 Please let me suggest a better approach → Could we review the wording together, ask a small group of people to test it, and then revise any confusing sections? Listenability好懂程度
    The intermediate version turns a general suggestion into a specific and cooperative proposal. The sequence of reviewing, testing, and revising gives the listener a practical next step and makes the response more persuasive.中高级版本将笼统的建议转化为具体、合作式的方案。审核、测试和修改的步骤为听者提供了切实可行的下一步，也让表达更有说服力。
Notes on this prompt这道题的讲解
  • I would like to explain why... is a polite and relatively formal way to begin. It introduces a disagreement more diplomatically than simply saying I disagree, without weakening the speaker's position.I would like to explain why... 是一种礼貌而正式的开场方式。它能够自然地引出不同意见，比直接使用 I disagree 更委婉，但并没有削弱表达立场的力度。
  • Could we...? is often used to make suggestions in workplace communication, even though it takes the form of a question. It communicates an idea while leaving room for the other person to participate.Could we...? 虽然使用疑问句形式，但在职场交流中经常用于提出建议。它既能表达自己的想法，也给对方留下参与讨论的空间。
  • That said is a useful linking expression meaning nevertheless or despite what has just been mentioned. It allows speakers to acknowledge another perspective before presenting the position they still maintain.That said 是一个常用的衔接表达，意思是话虽如此或尽管如此。它可以在承认对方观点之后，引出自己仍然坚持的立场。

What changes from level to level每升一级换了什么

  • 5–6 → 7–8 you need to stop interrupting → I needed him to let others finish before responding Task Fulfillment完成任务
    The revised expression communicates a clear behavioural expectation without sounding unnecessarily aggressive. It focuses on a specific action the colleague can change.升级后的表达清楚地传达了行为要求，同时避免显得过于强硬。它聚焦于同事能够实际改变的具体行为。
  • 7–8 → 9+ we agreed to try this approach → agreed to adopt this approach for future meetings Vocabulary词汇
    The upgraded expression sounds more deliberate and professional. It emphasizes an ongoing agreement that can guide future meetings rather than a temporary suggestion.升级后的表达更加严谨和专业。它强调的是能够指导未来会议的持续性约定，而不是一次性的建议。
  • 5–6 → 7–8 wanted everyone to speak → I wanted to make sure every colleague had room to contribute Content / Coherence内容与连贯
    The revised wording makes the goal of inclusive participation more explicit. It shifts attention from simply allowing people to speak to ensuring that every colleague has a meaningful opportunity to contribute.升级后的表达更加明确地说明了包容性参与的目标。它将重点从简单地允许别人发言，转向确保每位同事都有真正参与和贡献的机会。
Notes on this prompt这道题的讲解
  • When expressing disagreement, acknowledge the other person's strengths before identifying the specific problem. This structure remains polite without weakening your position.在表达不同意见时，可以先肯定对方的优点，再指出具体问题。这样的结构既保持礼貌，也不会削弱表达的坚定性。
  • Firmly but politely does not mean using vague language. A clear behavioural request, such as let others finish speaking, is easier to act on than simply saying be more considerate.Firmly but politely 并不意味着使用含糊的语言。清晰的行为要求，例如 let others finish speaking，比单纯说 be more considerate 更容易执行。
  • Structures such as while, without, and rather than help express contrast and concession, making your response sound more natural and sophisticated.可以使用 while、without 和 rather than 等结构表达对比和让步，使回答听起来更自然，也更有层次。

Prompt题目 39 School and learning上学与学习

Imagine that your teacher gives your class a group assignment, but the instructions are confusing. Your classmates have different ideas about what they need to submit, and the disagreement is slowing down your progress. Explain the problem to your teacher firmly but politely. Describe what is unclear, give an example, and explain what clarification you need. 假设老师给全班布置了一项小组作业，但作业说明令人困惑。你的同学对需要提交什么有不同理解，而且这种分歧正在拖慢你们的进度。请坚定而礼貌地向老师解释问题。描述哪些地方不清楚，举出一个例子，并说明你需要老师澄清什么。

  2. Give a specific example of the different interpretations among classmates.举出一个具体例子，说明同学之间存在的不同理解。
  3. Clearly request an explanation and describe how it would help your group.明确提出澄清请求，并说明这会如何帮助你们小组。

What changes from level to level每升一级换了什么

That said, I feel strongly that it belongs there. The flood is woven into our town’s collective memory, and families who lost their homes haven’t forgotten a thing. If we cherry-pick the cheerful moments, we’ll end up presenting a sanitized version of the past, which could come across as dismissing what they went through. Rather than cutting it, let’s handle it with the care it deserves. We could highlight how neighbours pulled together to rebuild, and check with those families before displaying any personal photos. How about we draft it together this week and see how you feel then?

What changes from level to level每升一级换了什么

  • 5–6 → 7–8 I understand that it is sad → I completely understand that it might upset some visitors Task Fulfillment完成任务
    It names the other person’s actual worry, the effect on visitors, so the disagreement that follows sounds considerate and well aimed.它点出了对方真正担心的问题，即对参观者的影响，使随后的不同意见显得体贴而有针对性。
  • 7–8 → 9+ present it sensitively → handle it with the care it deserves Vocabulary词汇
    The phrase conveys both sensitivity and respect, suggesting the event has earned careful treatment, which strengthens the case for keeping it.这一表达同时传递出细心与尊重，暗示这段往事理应被认真对待，从而增强了保留它的理由。
  • 5–6 → 7–8 the display is not true → we won’t be giving people an honest picture of the past Content / Coherence内容与连贯
    It explains the real consequence of leaving the event out: visitors would be misled about the past, which is more persuasive than a flat claim of being untrue.它说明了删去此事的实际后果：参观者无法了解真实的过去，这比简单地说展览不真实更有说服力。
Notes on this prompt这道题的讲解
  • A polite but firm structure first acknowledges the concern, then uses ‘still’ or ‘that said’ to turn to your position, and finally offers a workable solution.礼貌而坚定的结构是先认同对方顾虑，再用 still 或 that said 转折亮明立场，最后给出可行方案。
  • ’Cherry-pick’ means choosing only the favourable or attractive parts and carries criticism, so using ‘we’ as the subject sounds gentler than using ‘you’.cherry-pick 指只挑对自己有利或好看的部分，带有批评意味，使用时主语用 we 比用 you 更委婉。

Prompt题目 41 Migration and policy移民与政策

You volunteer at a settlement help desk. A newcomer asks you to submit an official application on their behalf, but the rules do not allow you to do this. Explain the situation firmly but politely, and offer another way to help. 你在一个移民安置服务台做志愿者。一位新移民请你代他提交一份正式申请，但规定不允许你这样做。请坚定而礼貌地解释情况，并提供另一种帮助方式。

Plan: three points to cover提纲：要讲的三点
  1. Acknowledge the request and say clearly that you cannot do it先回应对方的请求，并明确表示你不能这样做
  2. Explain the rule and why it protects the person解释规定，以及它为什么是在保护当事人
  3. Offer a practical alternative and check that they agree提出切实可行的替代方案，并确认对方同意

  • rather than /ˈrɑːðə ðæn/ 而不是

  • although /ɔːlˈðəʊ/ 虽然；尽管（后面不能再接 but）

  • economic /ˌiːkəˈnɒmɪk/ 经济（学）的，与经济有关的
    One side emphasizes economic growth, cultural exchange, and the need for workers. What Does Fair Migration Really Mean?

What changes from level to level每升一级换了什么

  • 5–6 → 7–8 If I do it, there could be a problem for you → If I did it for you, it could cause complications that would end up hurting you Content / Coherence内容与连贯
    The Level 7 version explains the risk in a more developed way, showing that the rule exists to protect the person. This adds stronger content and makes the refusal sound reasoned rather than abrupt.7 分版本把风险解释得更充分，表明规定是为了保护当事人，内容更有说服力，拒绝听起来有理有据而不生硬。
  • 7–8 → 9+ send it in yourself → be the one to press submit Vocabulary词汇
    The Level 9 phrase is more vivid and idiomatic, because it points to the exact action and puts the person in control. It also varies the sentence structure instead of repeating a plain verb phrase.9 分版本的表达更生动地道，指出了具体动作并让对方掌握主动权，句式也有变化，而不是重复简单的动词短语。
  • 5–6 → 7–8 Please come back tomorrow with your papers → If you could bring your documents back tomorrow morning, we can prepare everything together Task Fulfillment完成任务
    The Level 8 version makes the alternative more specific and polite by using a conditional request and a clear time. This fulfils the task of offering another way to help in a practical, courteous way.8 分版本用条件式请求和明确的时间，使替代方案更具体、更礼貌，更好地完成了提供其他帮助方式的任务要求。
Notes on this prompt这道题的讲解
  • When refusing politely, do not only say I cannot. First show understanding, then say I am afraid I am not able to, and finally use that said to turn to the help you can offer, which sounds more tactful.委婉拒绝时，不要只说 I cannot。先表示理解，再说 I am afraid I am not able to，最后用 That said 转向你能提供的帮助，语气会更得体。
  • When explaining a rule, use phrases like the rules require or it is a requirement that. Avoid a word for word translation of does not allow me do, which is ungrammatical.说明规定时，常用 The rules require... 或 It is a requirement that...，不要直译成 The rule does not allow me do，后者有语法错误。

Prompt题目 42 Money, banking and credit钱、银行与信用

A friend asks to borrow a large amount of money from you, but you cannot lend it. Explain your decision firmly but politely, and suggest another way to help. 一位朋友向你借一大笔钱，但你无法借给他。请坚定而礼貌地解释你的决定，并提出另一种帮助的方式。

Plan: three points to cover提纲：要讲的三点
  1. Show that you understand your friend’s situation and thank them for trusting you.表示你理解朋友的处境，并感谢对方的信任。
  2. Say clearly that you cannot lend the money and give a short, honest reason.明确说明你无法借钱，并给出简短而诚实的理由。
  3. Suggest another way to help, such as talking to a bank or making a budget plan.提出其他帮助方式，比如向银行咨询或一起做预算计划。

  • because /bɪˈkɒz/ 因为（引出原因，后面不能再接 so）
    She removed the overdraft service and moved us to an account without a monthly fee, because by then we had a regular salary going in. What We Signed on Day One
  • credit card /ˈkredɪt kɑːd/ 信用卡
    Then I looked at a statement properly and saw that we were also paying for an overdraft service we had never used, and for a credit card with a yearly fee that nobody had explained. What We Signed on Day One
  • hang up /ˌhæŋ ˈʌp/ 挂断电话
    If you hang up, the money will be lost." "Then I will deal with it myself," Tom said. The Call That Was Not from the Bank

green绿色 = new compared with the level below＝比下一级新加的说法 · dashed虚线 = what the next level replaces＝下一级要换掉的说法 · underlined下划线 = a point taught on this site (tap to open it)＝本站教过的知识点（点开去学）

What changes from level to level每升一级换了什么

  • 5–6 → 7–8 Maybe you can talk to your bank → It might be worth speaking to your bank about your options Vocabulary词汇
    The upgraded sentence sounds softer and more polite because it uses a gentle suggestion and mentions the person’s options instead of giving a short instruction.升级后的句子更委婉礼貌，用温和的建议并提到对方的“选择”，而不是简短的指示。
  • 7–8 → 9+ I am afraid I cannot lend you that amount → I’m afraid lending that amount is simply not something I can do Listenability好懂程度
    The upgraded sentence turns a direct refusal into a smoother, more natural structure, so the firm message is easier to listen to and still polite.升级后的句子把直接拒绝改成更流畅自然的结构，立场依然坚定，听起来更顺耳也更礼貌。
  • 5–6 → 7–8 I hope you understand → I hope you can see where I am coming from Task Fulfillment完成任务
    The upgraded phrase softens the closing and shows empathy, which helps fulfil the task of being firm but polite.升级后的短语让结尾更柔和并体现同理心，更好地完成“坚定但礼貌”的任务要求。
Notes on this prompt这道题的讲解
  • When refusing someone, a Chinese speaker might simply apologise and say they cannot do it. In English, starting with I’m afraid is a more formal and gentle opening, which suits a firm but polite answer in the exam.拒绝别人时，中文常说“不好意思，我借不了”。英语里 I’m afraid... 是更正式、更委婉的开头，适合在考试中表达“坚定但礼貌”。
  • Pay attention to the direction of lend and borrow. Lend means to give something to someone for a while, and borrow means to take it. Chinese uses one word for both, so learners often mix them up.注意 lend 和 borrow 的方向：lend 是“借出”，borrow 是“借入”。中文都说“借”，所以学习者容易混淆。

Prompt题目 43 Negotiation and conflict谈判与冲突

Imagine that a coworker keeps asking you to cover their shifts at the last minute, and it has become a real problem for you. Explain to them, firmly but politely, why you can no longer do this and suggest a better arrangement. 假设一位同事总是在最后一刻请你替他代班，这已经给你造成了困扰。请坚定而礼貌地向他解释你为什么不能再这样做，并提出一个更好的安排。

Plan: three points to cover提纲：要讲的三点
  1. Open politely and describe the problem without blaming礼貌地开场，描述问题但不指责对方
  2. State clearly what you can no longer do and why明确说明你不能再做什么以及原因
  3. Offer a fair alternative and thank them for understanding提出公平的替代方案，并感谢对方的理解

green绿色 = new compared with the level below＝比下一级新加的说法 · dashed虚线 = what the next level replaces＝下一级要换掉的说法 · underlined下划线 = a point taught on this site (tap to open it)＝本站教过的知识点（点开去学）

What changes from level to level每升一级换了什么

  • 5–6 → 7–8 I like helping you, but now I am very tired → I genuinely enjoy supporting you, but covering so many shifts has started to wear me down Vocabulary词汇
    The upgraded sentence keeps the warm tone but explains the effect on you with a natural phrase (‘wear me down’) and a stronger verb (‘genuinely enjoy supporting’). It sounds sincere and gives a clearer reason than simply saying you are tired.升级后的句子保持了友好的语气，同时用自然的短语（wear me down）和更有力的动词（genuinely enjoy supporting）说明对自己的影响，比单纯说累了更真诚、理由也更清楚。
  • 7–8 → 9+ advance notice → a heads-up well in advance Vocabulary词汇
    The Level 9 phrase is more specific and friendlier than the plain noun phrase. ‘A heads-up well in advance’ is a natural spoken expression that makes the request sound relaxed rather than formal.9 分版本的短语比普通名词短语更具体、更亲切。a heads-up well in advance 是自然的口语表达，让请求听起来轻松而不生硬。
  • 5–6 → 7–8 From now on, I cannot say yes every time → I’m afraid I won’t be able to agree to every request from now on Task Fulfillment完成任务
    The upgraded phrase states the limit clearly but softens it with ‘I’m afraid’, which is exactly the firm-but-polite tone the task asks for. It sounds firmer and more respectful than a blunt refusal.升级后的说法清楚地表明了底线，又用 I’m afraid 缓和语气，正符合任务要求的坚定而礼貌，比直接拒绝更得体。
Notes on this prompt这道题的讲解
  • Saying a flat ‘I cannot’ can sound harsh. In English people often use ‘I’m afraid I won’t be able to...’ to stay polite while still being firm.中文里直接说我不能显得很硬；英语里常用 I’m afraid I won’t be able to... 来保持礼貌但态度依然坚定。
  • For giving advance warning, say ‘give someone notice’ or ‘give someone a heads-up’. Avoid ‘inform me early in advance’, because ‘early’ and ‘in advance’ repeat the same idea.提前通知可以说 give someone notice 或 give someone a heads-up，不要说 inform me early in advance，因为 early 和 in advance 意思重复。

Prompt题目 44 Finding a home找房与安家

Your landlord has just told you that he will show your apartment to new tenants tomorrow, with very little notice, and you will be at work. Explain to him, firmly but politely, why this does not work for you and what you would like instead. 房东刚刚通知你，明天要带新租客来看你住的公寓，通知时间非常仓促，而你那时在上班。请坚定而礼貌地向他解释为什么这样行不通，以及你希望怎样安排。

Plan: three points to cover提纲：要讲的三点
  1. Start politely: thank the landlord for telling you and show that you understand his situation.礼貌开场：感谢房东告知，并表示理解他的处境。
  2. State clearly why tomorrow does not work: you are at work and are not comfortable with strangers in your home.清楚说明为什么明天不行：你在上班，而且不愿让陌生人在家中走动。
  3. Offer a solution: ask for more notice in future and suggest another time you could be there.提出解决办法：请他今后提前通知，并建议另一个你能在场的时间。

What changes from level to level每升一级换了什么

  • 5–6 → 7–8 I do not want strangers in my apartment → I am not comfortable with strangers walking through my apartment while I am away Task Fulfillment完成任务
    The Level 7 version explains the real reason in a complete, polite sentence, which fulfils the task of being firm without sounding rude.7 分版本用完整而礼貌的句子说明真实原因，既坚定又不失礼貌，更好地完成了任务要求。
  • 7–8 → 9+ I would be happy to show the place myself on Saturday morning → I’d be glad to host the viewing myself on Saturday morning, if that suits you Vocabulary词汇
    Offering a solution with softer, more natural wording such as ‘glad to host’ and ‘if that suits you’ keeps a firm message friendly and sounds more idiomatic.用 glad to host、if that suits you 这类更柔和自然的措辞提出解决办法，让坚定的态度仍显友好，也更地道。
  • 5–6 → 7–8 Please tell me earlier next time. → With so little notice, I would appreciate more warning in the future, ideally a few days Content / Coherence内容与连贯
    Instead of a short command, the Level 7 version gives the reason (little notice) and a concrete request (more warning), which makes the content fuller and more persuasive.7 到 8 分之间的版本不再只是简短的要求，而是给出原因（通知太仓促）和具体请求（提前通知），内容更充实也更有说服力。
Notes on this prompt这道题的讲解
  • When refusing, use the ‘I understand... but...’ pattern to show empathy first and then state your position. This is the classic ‘firm but polite’ structure, and it avoids a blunt ‘No, I can’t’.表达拒绝时，先用 I understand... but... 的结构表示理解，再说明立场，这是“坚定而礼貌”的典型句式。避免直接说 No, I can’t，那样显得生硬。
  • Here ‘I’m afraid...’ does not mean fear; it softens bad news, like ‘unfortunately’. Also, ‘ideally’ introduces what you would prefer and sounds much gentler than ‘you must’.I’m afraid... 在这里不是“我害怕”，而是委婉地告知坏消息，意思接近“恐怕……”。另外，ideally 用来提出你更希望的做法，语气比 you must 柔和得多。

  3. Offer to post an honest version and hope she understands提出可以发布一个诚实的版本，并希望她能理解

green绿色 = new compared with the level below＝比下一级新加的说法 · dashed虚线 = what the next level replaces＝下一级要换掉的说法 · underlined下划线 = a point taught on this site (tap to open it)＝本站教过的知识点（点开去学）

What changes from level to level每升一级换了什么

  • 5–6 → 7–8 People might believe it and get hurt → Some readers might take it seriously and put their health at risk Content / Coherence内容与连贯
    The Level 7 version explains the risk more fully and links it to the speaker’s own sense of responsibility, so the refusal sounds reasoned instead of abrupt.7级版本更完整地解释了风险，并联系到说话人自己的责任感，让拒绝听起来有理有据，而不是生硬。
  • 7–8 → 9+ I am afraid I cannot post it in its current form → I am unable to publish it as it stands Listenability好懂程度
    The Level 9 phrase is softer and more formal, and it flows smoothly. It keeps the message firm while sounding professional and considerate.9级的表达更委婉、更正式，而且流畅自然。它在保持立场坚定的同时，听起来专业而体贴。
  • 5–6 → 7–8 Please change the words and send it again → If you reword the claims and send them back, I will share it straight away Task Fulfillment完成任务
    The Level 7-8 version turns a bare instruction into a clear conditional offer with a result, which fulfils the task of being firm but still helpful.7-8级版本把一个生硬的指令变成了带有结果的清晰条件式提议，更好地完成了“坚定但仍然乐于帮助”的任务要求。
Notes on this prompt这道题的讲解
  • When refusing, Chinese speakers often say ‘I cannot’ directly. In English it is usually more polite to thank or show understanding first, then introduce the refusal with ‘I am afraid’ or ‘regretfully’.拒绝别人时，中文常直接说“我不能”，英文通常先表示感谢或理解，再用 I am afraid 或 regretfully 引出拒绝，语气会更礼貌。
  • To say there is no proof, ‘I have not seen any evidence to support that’ sounds more objective and less likely to offend than saying ‘It is false’.想表达“没有证据”时，可以说 I have not seen any evidence to support that，比 It is false 更客观，也更不容易冒犯对方。

Prompt题目 46 Routines and habits作息与习惯

Imagine that you share a home with someone whose morning routine regularly disturbs your sleep. You have tried to be patient, but the situation is affecting your daily life. Explain the problem firmly but politely, suggest a reasonable solution, and explain why it is important for both of you to respect each other's routines. 假设你与某人合住，但对方的早晨作息经常影响你的睡眠。你已经尽量保持耐心，但这种情况正在影响你的日常生活。请坚定而礼貌地说明问题，提出一个合理的解决方案，并解释为什么你们双方都应该尊重彼此的作息习惯。

Plan: three points to cover提纲：要讲的三点
  1. Describe the repeated disturbance and how it affects you.描述反复出现的干扰，以及它对你的影响。
  2. Explain your request and suggest practical changes.说明你的要求，并提出切实可行的调整办法。
  3. Offer your own cooperation and aim for a fair agreement.表达自己愿意配合的态度，并争取达成公平的共识。

  • feel /fiːl/ 感觉；摸起来；感到

  • habit /ˈhæbɪt/ 习惯
    I have learned that a useful habit should support real life, not become another source of pressure. The Evening I Changed My Habits
  • prepare /prɪˈpeə(r)/ 准备
    I arrived home, prepared something quick to eat, and sat down with my phone. The Evening I Changed My Habits
  • also /ˈɔːlsəʊ/ 也；还（通常放在动词前、be 动词后）
    I also put my phone in another room while studying. The Evening I Changed My Habits

green绿色 = new compared with the level below＝比下一级新加的说法 · dashed虚线 = what the next level replaces＝下一级要换掉的说法 · underlined下划线 = a point taught on this site (tap to open it)＝本站教过的知识点（点开去学）

What changes from level to level每升一级换了什么

  • 5–6 → 7–8 wakes me earlier than I need to → wakes me well before I need to start my day Listenability好懂程度
    The revised expression explains the timing of the disturbance more naturally and gives the listener a clearer picture of how the repeated alarm affects the speaker's morning.修改后的表达更自然地说明了干扰发生的时间，让听者更清楚地理解反复响起的闹钟如何影响说话者的早晨。
  • 7–8 → 9+ agree on a practical arrangement → settle on a simple arrangement that gives us both a more peaceful start Task Fulfillment完成任务
    The upgraded expression moves beyond a basic request and emphasizes a mutually beneficial outcome. It makes the speaker sound constructive, considerate, and confident.升级后的表达不再只是提出一个简单要求，而是强调双方都能受益的结果，使说话者显得更有建设性、更体贴，也更有自信。
  • 5–6 → 7–8 I am not sleeping well → the interruptions are affecting my sleep Content / Coherence内容与连贯
    The revised wording identifies the specific consequence of the problem rather than giving only a general statement. This makes the explanation more convincing and relevant.修改后的表达明确指出了问题带来的具体后果，而不是笼统地表达不满，因此解释更有说服力，也更切合实际。
Notes on this prompt这道题的讲解
  • When expressing disagreement, using I understand..., but... allows you to acknowledge the other person's situation before clearly explaining your own difficulty. This approach usually encourages a more constructive conversation than direct criticism.在提出不同意见时，使用 I understand..., but... 可以先表示理解，再清楚地说明自己的困难。这种表达通常比直接指责对方更容易展开建设性对话。
  • Would you be willing to...? and Would you consider...? are polite ways to make requests. They are generally more suitable for everyday communication than directly saying You must...Would you be willing to...? 和 Would you consider...? 都是礼貌地提出请求的表达。它们比直接使用 You must... 更适合日常沟通。
  • When dealing with problems in shared living arrangements, you can use on my side or I can also... to describe what you are willing to contribute. This makes the proposed solution seem fairer instead of simply demanding that someone else change.在处理共同生活中的问题时，可以使用 on my side 或 I can also... 表达自己愿意承担的部分。这样可以让解决方案显得更加公平，而不是只要求别人改变。

Prompt题目 47 Schools and parents学校与家长

Your child’s school has invited her to a weekend program, but your family cannot agree to it. Explain politely but firmly to the teacher why she cannot attend, and suggest another option. 孩子的学校邀请她参加一个周末项目，但你们家无法同意。请礼貌而坚定地向老师解释她为什么不能参加，并提出另一种方案。

Plan: three points to cover提纲：要讲的三点
  1. Thank the teacher for the invitation and show you value it.感谢老师的邀请，并表示你很看重这件事。
  2. Explain clearly but kindly that your daughter cannot attend, and give your reason.清楚而友善地说明女儿不能参加，并给出理由。
  3. Suggest an alternative and promise to stay in touch.提出替代方案，并承诺保持联系。

What changes from level to level每升一级换了什么

  • 5–6 → 7–8 Our family has a plan on weekends → Weekends are set aside for our family commitments Listenability好懂程度
    The upgrade replaces a blunt, choppy statement with a smoother and more formal one, which sounds more respectful and is easier for a listener to follow when you are refusing something.升级后用更流畅、更正式的表达取代了生硬零碎的说法，在拒绝别人时听起来更尊重对方，也更容易听懂。
  • 7–8 → 9+ I’m afraid she won’t be able to attend → I must respectfully decline on her behalf Task Fulfillment完成任务
    The upgrade states the refusal clearly while keeping a very polite tone, which fulfils the task of being firm but courteous better than a softer, more uncertain phrase.升级后的说法在保持非常礼貌的同时把拒绝表达得很明确，比含糊委婉的说法更好地完成了‘坚定而有礼’的任务要求。
  • 5–6 → 7–8 Can she do extra work at home instead → Would it be possible for her to complete some extra work at home instead Vocabulary词汇
    The upgrade turns a short, direct question into a polite request with a more formal structure and more precise wording, which suits a conversation with a teacher.升级后把简短直接的问句变成结构更正式、用词更精准的礼貌请求，更适合与老师交谈的场合。
Notes on this prompt这道题的讲解
  • In Chinese a plain refusal can sound acceptable in school conversations, but in English it is more common to thank the person first and then soften the refusal with phrases such as I’m afraid or I must respectfully decline.中文里直接说‘不行’在家校沟通中并不少见，但英语里更常先表示感谢，再用 I’m afraid 或 I must respectfully decline 这类缓和的说法表达拒绝。
  • When you suggest an alternative, Would it be possible for her to... is more polite than a direct Can she..., and it fits the tone of speaking with a teacher.提出替代方案时，用 Would it be possible for her to... 比直接说 Can she... 更客气，也更符合与老师交流的语气。

Prompt题目 48 Sleep, stress and mental health睡眠、压力与心理健康

Your neighbour often has loud gatherings late at night, and you cannot sleep. Talk to your neighbour. Explain the problem firmly but politely, and ask for a change. 你的邻居经常在深夜举办吵闹的聚会，让你无法入睡。请与邻居交谈，坚定而礼貌地说明问题，并请对方做出改变。

Plan: three points to cover提纲：要讲的三点

  3. Make a clear request and mention the next step politely提出明确请求，并礼貌地提到下一步打算

What changes from level to level每升一级换了什么

  • 5–6 → 7–8 please make less noise → you could keep the volume down after ten o’clock Task Fulfillment完成任务
    The Level 7 request is a polite conditional with a clear, specific action. It fulfils the task better because it is firm about what you want but still sounds courteous.7分版本用礼貌的条件句提出清晰、具体的请求，既坚定地表明诉求，又保持客气，更好地完成了任务要求。
  • 7–8 → 9+ I appreciate your help → I’d be genuinely grateful for your cooperation Vocabulary词汇
    The Level 9 closing is a warmer, more precise way to thank someone. It sounds natural and ends the message on a cooperative note.9分版本的结尾用更温和、更精确的措辞表达感谢，听起来自然，并以合作的语气收尾。
  • 5–6 → 7–8 If it continues → Should the problem continue Listenability好懂程度
    The Level 8 phrase is an inverted conditional. It sounds more polished and makes the warning gentler, so the listener hears a consequence rather than a threat.8分版本使用倒装条件句，听起来更正式、更得体，也让警告显得更温和，对方听到的是后果而不是威胁。
Notes on this prompt这道题的讲解
  • To sound firm but polite, first show understanding with I completely understand, then name the problem after but, and finally make your request. This makes it less likely to offend the other person.想表达“坚定但礼貌”，可以先表示理解（I completely understand...），再用 but 说出问题，最后提出请求，这样不容易冒犯对方。
  • When you ask a favour, would you mind and I would appreciate it if you could are softer than you must or you should. They suit conversations between neighbours.请求别人时，would you mind 和 I would appreciate it if you could 比 you must 或 you should 更委婉，适合邻里之间的沟通。

Prompt题目 49 Art and taste艺术与品味

Imagine that you are helping organize a community art exhibition. An artist wants you to include their sculpture, but you believe it does not match the exhibition's theme. Explain your decision firmly but politely. Acknowledge the artist's effort, give clear reasons for your choice, and suggest a constructive alternative. 假设你正在协助组织一场社区艺术展。一位艺术家希望你展出他们的雕塑，但你认为这件作品与展览主题不符。请坚定而礼貌地解释你的决定。肯定艺术家的付出，清楚说明你作出这一选择的原因，并提出一个建设性的替代方案。

Plan: three points to cover提纲：要讲的三点
  1. Recognize the artist's creativity and the effort behind the sculpture.肯定艺术家的创造力，以及这件雕塑背后的付出。
  2. Explain why the sculpture does not align with the exhibition's focus.解释为什么这件雕塑与展览的重点不一致。
  3. Communicate your decision respectfully and suggest another opportunity.尊重地表达你的决定，并提出其他展示机会。
Chunks from the same topic you could use可以用上的同主题词块
  • explain /ɪkˈspleɪn/ 解释；说明
    Visitor: I suppose that explains why two people can disagree so strongly about the same work. Who Decides What Is Beautiful?
  • while /waɪl/ 而（表示对比）；当……时
    Some visitors see an abstract painting in a quiet gallery, while others encounter the same image alongside historical photographs. Beyond First Impressions: Rethinking Artistic Taste
  • taste /teɪst/ 尝起来；味道；品尝
    Taste tends to reflect personal histories as well as broader social influences. Who Decides What Is Beautiful?
  • also /ˈɔːlsəʊ/ 也；还（通常放在动词前、be 动词后）
    The work also involves memory, movement, and cultural context. Who Decides What Is Beautiful?
  • suggest that /səˈdʒest ðət/ 表明；暗示
    Early observations suggest that visitors often respond differently when they receive information about an artist's intentions. Beyond First Impressions: Rethinking Artistic Taste

green绿色 = new compared with the level below＝比下一级新加的说法 · dashed虚线 = what the next level replaces＝下一级要换掉的说法 · underlined下划线 = a point taught on this site (tap to open it)＝本站教过的知识点（点开去学）

What changes from level to level每升一级换了什么

  • 5–6 → 7–8 It does not fit the theme → it falls outside the exhibition's focus Task Fulfillment完成任务
    The upgraded expression communicates the problem in a more diplomatic and professional way. It focuses on the relationship between the artwork and the exhibition rather than making the artist feel that their work is being dismissed.升级后的表达更加委婉、专业。它把重点放在作品与展览之间的关系上，而不是让艺术家觉得自己的创作遭到了否定。
  • 7–8 → 9+ Art can be interpreted in many ways → It sits outside the exhibition's central theme Content / Coherence内容与连贯
    The advanced version distinguishes between the artistic value of an individual work and its suitability for a particular exhibition. This distinction makes the explanation more nuanced, persuasive, and respectful.高级版本区分了一件作品本身的艺术价值与它是否适合某个特定展览。这种区分让解释更加细腻、有说服力，也更尊重艺术家。
  • 5–6 → 7–8 We have to choose works that connect with the display → We need to keep the selection coherent for visitors Task Fulfillment完成任务
    The improved wording explains the practical curatorial objective behind the decision. Instead of merely saying that the work must connect with the display, it gives the listener a clear reason for maintaining consistency across the exhibition.升级后的表达说明了作出这一策展决定背后的实际目标。它不再只是说作品需要与展览相关，而是清楚解释为什么需要保持整个展览的一致性。
Notes on this prompt这道题的讲解
  • I appreciate the effort you have put into... is a polite way to acknowledge someone's contribution before expressing a disagreement. It is particularly useful in artistic collaborations, team discussions, and professional situations.I appreciate the effort you have put into... 是一种先肯定对方付出、再表达不同意见的礼貌表达。它特别适合艺术合作、团队讨论和工作场合。
  • Align with emphasizes consistency between two things in terms of goals, direction, or standards. It is often more appropriate than simply using fit in formal discussions, as in align with the exhibition's theme.Align with 强调两个事物在目标、方向或标准上的一致。它比简单使用 fit 更适合正式讨论，例如 align with the exhibition's theme。
  • Artistic merit refers to the artistic value or quality of a work. It helps speakers distinguish personal preferences, exhibition themes, and professional evaluations, avoiding the impression that rejecting a piece means denying its value.Artistic merit 指作品本身的艺术价值或艺术品质。它可以帮助说话者区分个人喜好、展览主题和专业评价，避免把不选择某件作品说成否定其价值。

Prompt题目 50 The ethics of technology科技伦理

A relative wants to post photos of your young child on social media and share where you live. Explain to them firmly but politely why you would prefer that they do not, and suggest another way to share the pictures. 一位亲戚想把你年幼孩子的照片发到社交媒体上，并分享你们的住处。请坚定而礼貌地向对方解释你为什么不希望这样做，并提出另一种分享照片的方式。

Plan: three points to cover提纲：要讲的三点
  1. Thank the relative and acknowledge their good intentions感谢亲戚并肯定对方的好意
  2. Explain clearly why you are not comfortable with public posting清楚解释你为什么不愿意公开发布
  3. Offer a private way to share and thank them for understanding提出私下分享的方式，并感谢对方的理解

green绿色 = new compared with the level below＝比下一级新加的说法 · dashed虚线 = what the next level replaces＝下一级要换掉的说法 · underlined下划线 = a point taught on this site (tap to open it)＝本站教过的知识点（点开去学）

What changes from level to level每升一级换了什么

  • 5–6 → 7–8 Strangers can see them and use them → Once they are online, strangers can copy them and use them in ways we can never control Content / Coherence内容与连贯
    The upgrade explains the real danger: once photos are online, other people can copy them and nobody can control how they are used. This gives a stronger, more specific reason than saying strangers can see them.升级后的表达解释了真正的风险：照片一旦上网，别人就可以复制，而且无人能控制其用途。这比只说陌生人能看到更有力、更具体。
  • 7–8 → 9+ and you are welcome to show them to your friends in person → and you are more than welcome to share them with friends over a cup of tea Listenability好懂程度
    The new ending adds a warm, friendly picture of sharing over tea. It keeps the tone polite and natural, so the firm message is easier for the listener to accept.新的结尾增加了一幅温馨友好的喝茶分享画面，语气礼貌自然，让坚定的态度更容易被听者接受。
  • 5–6 → 7–8 I hope you can understand my choice → I hope you will respect our decision, even though it may seem strict Task Fulfillment完成任务
    The upgrade softens the refusal by admitting that the decision may seem strict. This is how a speaker stays firm but polite, which is exactly what the task requires.升级后的表达承认这个决定也许显得严格，从而缓和了拒绝的语气。这正是既坚定又礼貌的做法，符合任务的要求。
Notes on this prompt这道题的讲解
  • When declining an older relative, Chinese speakers often speak very indirectly. In English you can use However or That said to appreciate the person first and then state your position clearly, which is polite without being vague.向长辈拒绝时，中文常说得很委婉。英语里可以用 However 或 That said 先肯定对方，再清楚说出自己的立场，这样既礼貌又不含糊。
  • Note that not comfortable with must be followed by a noun or a gerund, as in not comfortable with her pictures appearing online. Do not write not comfortable to post.注意 not comfortable with 后面要接名词或动名词，例如 not comfortable with her pictures appearing online。不要写成 not comfortable to post。

Prompt题目 51 Travel and its footprint旅行与它的代价

A friend has invited you to join a cheap animal photo tour that you believe harms wildlife. Explain to your friend, firmly but politely, why you will not join, and suggest another plan. 一位朋友邀请你参加一个便宜的动物拍照旅游项目，而你认为这对野生动物有害。请坚定而礼貌地向朋友解释你为什么不参加，并提出另一个方案。

Plan: three points to cover提纲：要讲的三点
  1. Thank your friend and say clearly that you have decided not to join.先感谢朋友，并明确表示你决定不参加。
  2. Give your main reason calmly, without blaming your friend.冷静地说出主要原因，不要指责朋友。
  3. Offer a better alternative and show that you still want to spend time together.提出更好的替代方案，并表明你仍然想和朋友一起度过时光。

    In peak season it is something else. A Village Asks Day-Trippers to Book Ahead
  • footprint /ˈfʊtprɪnt/ （对环境、社区造成的）影响，足迹
    The footprint of a visit, they point out, is not only the carbon from the drive; it is also the traffic, the rubbish and the rents. A Village Asks Day-Trippers to Book Ahead
  • look /lʊk/ 看起来，显得
    "People look out of the window on a sunny morning and think of us. A Village Asks Day-Trippers to Book Ahead
  • depend on /dɪˈpend ɒn/ 取决于；依赖；依靠
    A café owner said the booking system would have an impact on small businesses that depend on visitors who decide on the day. A Village Asks Day-Trippers to Book Ahead

Three sample answers on the same plan同一骨架的三级示范

CELPIP 5–6 · ≈B1 83 words词

Hi Sam, thank you for inviting me to the animal photo tour. It sounds fun, but I cannot join. The animals look unhappy in the photos and I think the tour is bad for them. I know you are excited, so I do not want to upset you. Can we go to a nature park instead? We can still take nice photos and see animals in a safe way. I hope you understand. Please tell me if you want to plan something together.

CELPIP 7–8 · ≈B2 117 words词

Hi Sam, thanks so much for inviting me to the animal photo tour. It sounds like a lot of fun, but I have decided not to join. From what I have read, the animals are often kept in poor conditions to please tourists, and I would feel uncomfortable supporting that. I completely understand that you are excited, and I do not want to spoil your plans. How about visiting a licensed nature reserve together instead? We could still take wonderful photos and watch the animals behaving naturally. I really hope you can see where I am coming from. If you like, I can look up some options this weekend, and we can choose the best one together.

CELPIP 9+ · ≈C1 134 words词

Hi Sam, thanks so much for the invitation to the animal photo tour. It sounds like a lot of fun, but I have decided not to join. From what I have read, the animals are often kept in poor conditions to please tourists, and I could not, in good conscience, put my money behind that. I completely understand that you are excited, and the last thing I want is to spoil your plans. How about visiting a licensed nature reserve together instead? We could still take wonderful photos and watch the animals behaving naturally. I truly hope you can see where I am coming from. If you like, I can research a few options this weekend, and we can pick the best one together. Either way, I would love to plan something with you.

green绿色 = new compared with the level below＝比下一级新加的说法 · dashed虚线 = what the next level replaces＝下一级要换掉的说法 · underlined下划线 = a point taught on this site (tap to open it)＝本站教过的知识点（点开去学）

What changes from level to level每升一级换了什么

  • 5–6 → 7–8 The animals look unhappy in the photos → From what I have read, the animals are often kept in poor conditions to please tourists Content / Coherence内容与连贯
    The Level 7 version gives a reason with more substance. Instead of only describing how the animals look, it explains the likely cause and connects it to the tour, which makes the argument more convincing and fair.7分版本给出的理由更有分量：不只是描述动物的样子，而是解释可能的原因并与旅游项目联系起来，让论点更有说服力，也更客观。
  • 7–8 → 9+ I would feel uncomfortable supporting that → I could not, in good conscience, put my money behind that Listenability好懂程度
    The Level 9 version uses a more formal and idiomatic expression to state a firm position. It sounds confident and polite at the same time, which is exactly the tone this kind of task needs.9分版本用更正式、更地道的说法表达坚定立场，听起来既自信又礼貌，正是这类任务需要的语气。
  • 5–6 → 7–8 Can we go to a nature park instead? → How about visiting a licensed nature reserve together instead? Task Fulfillment完成任务
    The Level 8 version turns a short, direct question into a more specific and friendly suggestion. A concrete alternative fulfils the task better because it shows you are offering a real solution, not just refusing.8分版本把简短直接的问句改成更具体、更友好的建议。给出具体的替代方案更能完成任务，因为这表明你是在提供解决办法，而不只是拒绝。
Notes on this prompt这道题的讲解
  • When declining, the direct Chinese way of saying I cannot go can sound blunt. In English, saying ‘thanks so much’ first and then ‘I have decided not to join’ is more polite and just as firm.拒绝别人时，中文常说“我不能去”，听起来很直接。英文里先说 thanks so much 再说 I have decided not to join，语气更礼貌，也同样坚定。
  • To soften your tone, use would and could, as in ‘I would feel uncomfortable’ or ‘We could still take photos’. These sound gentler than will and can.想让语气更委婉时，可以用 would 和 could，例如 I would feel uncomfortable 或 We could still take photos，比直接用 will 和 can 更柔和。

Prompt题目 52 Science and uncertainty科学与不确定

Your supervisor asks you to tell a customer that a test result is guaranteed to be correct. Explain politely but firmly why you cannot promise this, and suggest a better way to communicate it. 你的主管要你告诉一位客户，某项检测结果保证准确无误。请礼貌而坚定地解释你为什么不能这样承诺，并提出一个更好的沟通方式。

Plan: three points to cover提纲：要讲的三点
  1. Show that you understand why your supervisor wants to reassure the customer表示理解主管为什么想让客户放心
  2. Explain that every measurement has a margin of error解释任何测量都存在误差范围
  3. Suggest an honest way to describe the result and offer to help提出一种诚实的说法，并主动提供帮助
Chunks from the same topic you could use可以用上的同主题词块
  • rather than /ˈrɑːðə ðæn/ 而不是
    A result that appears only once, in one laboratory, is best treated as a lead rather than a fact. How Scientists Measure What They Do Not Know
  • margin of error /ˈmɑːdʒɪn əv ˈerə/ 误差范围
    Journalists, for their part, are likely to serve readers better if they report the size of the margin of error alongside the dramatic number. Why Changing Our Minds Is Science Working
  • evidence /ˈevɪdəns/ 证据；支持某种观点或结论的信息
    On the whole, it is the clearest evidence that the system is doing its job, and a society that cannot tolerate that kind of honesty will end up believing something far worse. Why Changing Our Minds Is Science Working
  • by and large /ˌbaɪ ən ˈlɑːdʒ/ 总的来说
    It is a method for reducing error, and by and large it works because it admits that error is possible. Why Changing Our Minds Is Science Working
  • likely to /ˈlaɪkli tə/ 可能会
    Journalists, for their part, are likely to serve readers better if they report the size of the margin of error alongside the dramatic number. Why Changing Our Minds Is Science Working

Three sample answers on the same plan同一骨架的三级示范

CELPIP 5–6 · ≈B1 79 words词

Hello, thank you for asking me about the customer. I understand that you want to make her happy, but I cannot say the result is one hundred percent sure. Every test has some small error, and nobody can remove all of it. If we promise too much, the customer may lose trust in us later. I think we should say the result is very likely correct and explain the small risk. This way we are honest and still helpful.

Points from this site used here:这一栏用到的本站知识点： Verb + -ing or to: the common verbsGradable and extreme adjectives: very tired, absolutely exhaustedQuantifiers: all, most, each, every, eitherEveryday verbs beyond get and goNumbers, dates, prices and quantities

CELPIP 7–8 · ≈B2 112 words词

Thank you for raising the customer’s request. I completely understand that you want to reassure her, but I am afraid I cannot describe the result as guaranteed. Every measurement carries a margin of error, and no method can eliminate it entirely. If we promise certainty, we could damage her confidence in our work if the result changes later. Instead, I suggest we tell her that the result is very likely correct and explain, in simple terms, what the small risk means for her decision. That way we stay honest, we protect our reputation, and she still receives clear advice. If you like, I can prepare a short summary for her this afternoon.

Points from this site used here:这一栏用到的本站知识点： Verb + -ing or to: the common verbsReal conditionals and time clausesEveryday verbs beyond get and goLinkers without doublingNear-synonyms: say, tell, speak, talk and othersFormal and informal pairs

CELPIP 9+ · ≈C1 128 words词

Thank you for raising the customer’s request. I fully appreciate that you want to put her mind at ease, but I am afraid I cannot in good conscience describe the result as guaranteed. Every measurement carries a margin of error, and no method can eliminate it entirely. If we promise certainty, we could damage her confidence in our work the moment the result changes. What I would propose instead is that we tell her the result is reliable within a clearly stated range of confidence, and explain, in plain language, what the remaining risk means for her decision. That way we stay honest, we protect our reputation, and she still receives clear guidance. If it would be helpful, I can draft a short summary for her this afternoon.

green绿色 = new compared with the level below＝比下一级新加的说法 · dashed虚线 = what the next level replaces＝下一级要换掉的说法 · underlined下划线 = a point taught on this site (tap to open it)＝本站教过的知识点（点开去学）

What changes from level to level每升一级换了什么

  • 5–6 → 7–8 Every test has some small error → Every measurement carries a margin of error Vocabulary词汇
    The Level 7 wording uses the precise term ‘margin of error’ instead of the vague idea of ‘some small error’. This sounds more professional and shows that the speaker understands how measurements work.7 分版本用精确术语 margin of error 取代了模糊的“有一点小误差”，听起来更专业，也显示说话人懂得测量的基本道理。
  • 7–8 → 9+ very likely correct → reliable within a clearly stated range of confidence Content / Coherence内容与连贯
    The Level 9 wording replaces a loose phrase with a precise, scientific way of describing certainty: the result is reliable within a stated range. This gives the customer something concrete and shows real command of the topic.9 分版本把含糊的“很可能正确”换成了更精确、更科学的说法：在明确范围内可靠。这给客户具体信息，也显示出对话题的真正掌握。
  • 5–6 → 7–8 the customer may lose trust in us later → we could damage her confidence in our work if the result changes later Task Fulfillment完成任务
    The Level 8 wording spells out the actual consequence of over-promising, damaged confidence if the result changes, which makes the firm refusal more convincing and fulfils the task of explaining the problem clearly.8 分版本把过度承诺的实际后果说清楚了：结果一旦改变就会损害客户信心。这让坚定的拒绝更有说服力，也更好地完成了“清楚解释问题”的任务要求。
Notes on this prompt这道题的讲解
  • ’I am afraid I cannot...’ is a fixed polite way to refuse. Here ‘afraid’ means ‘I am sorry to say’, so do not translate it literally as being scared.I am afraid I cannot… 是委婉拒绝的固定说法，这里的 afraid 表示“恐怕”，不要直译成“我害怕”。
  • The natural term is ‘margin of error’, not a made-up phrase like ‘error range’. Showing understanding first, then using ‘but’, then offering an alternative keeps the tone firm and polite.“误差范围”说 margin of error，不要自造 error range。先表示理解，再说 but，再给替代方案，语气会既坚定又礼貌。

Rate yourself on the four dimensions按四个评分维度自评

Listen back to your recording. Compare it with the three sample columns and pick the closest level for each dimension.回放你的录音，和三栏示范比，每个维度选最接近的级别。

🆚 What each level sounds like on this task这个任务上各级别听起来什么样

For every prompt we wrote three versions: Level 5–6, 7–8 and 9+. The skeleton is the same; each level adds to the four rating dimensions. Find the column that sounds most like you, then see which sentences the next column changes.同一道题，我们写了三个级别的示范：5–6 级、7–8 级、9 级以上。内容骨架一样，差别只在四个评分维度上一级一级往上加。先找到和自己最像的那一栏，再看下一栏把哪几句换掉了。

CELPIP 5–6 · ≈B1
  • States the problem and the request, but bluntly (I want..., Please give me...), which can sound harsh.说清了问题和要求，但很直接（I want…、Please give me…），听起来有点硬。
  • Short reasons with no concrete facts (dates, times, amounts).理由短，没有具体事实（日期、次数、金额）。
  • Rarely offers an alternative.很少给替代方案。
CELPIP 7–8 · ≈B2
  • Uses polite patterns such as Could you please and I'd really appreciate.用 Could you please、I'd really appreciate 等礼貌句型。
  • Gives concrete facts (three weeks, twice, sixty-eight dollars).给出具体事实（三周、两次、六十八元）。
  • Offers one or two alternatives when refusing; states the outcome wanted when complaining.拒绝时给一到两个替代方案；投诉时说清希望的结果。
CELPIP 9+ · ≈C1
  • Firm but face-saving: mix-up or glitch instead of mistake, and an offer to settle privately before the consequence.语气「坚定但给面子」：mix-up、glitch 代替 mistake，先表达愿意私下解决再说后果。
  • Speaks from the listener's side (whichever is easier on your end) and offers to handle the next step.从对方角度说话（whichever is easier on your end），主动揽下后续。
  • Consequences have a clear deadline, and "have no choice but to" makes them sound unavoidable.后果有明确期限，用 have no choice but to 显得不得已。

Why people get stuck at 7为什么常卡在 7 级

  • Wrong tone: too casual with a landlord or manager, too formal with a friend. The official Level 8 sample lost marks for ending with "Thanks for listening".语气不对：对房东、经理太随便，对朋友太正式。官方 8 级样本就因为结尾说了 Thanks for listening 被扣分。
  • Describes the problem but not what you want done.只说问题，不说希望对方做什么。
  • The position wobbles between refusing and agreeing.立场前后摇摆，一会儿拒绝一会儿又像答应。

Three moves to 9+冲 9 级以上的三步

  • Before speaking, decide three things: who you are talking to, what you want, what alternative you offer.开口前定好三件事：对谁说、要什么、给什么替代方案。
  • Keep two softeners ready: mix-up, I'd rather, I'm afraid.准备两个「软化」的词：mix-up、I'd rather、I'm afraid。
  • End with a call to action (Just let me know...), not "Thanks for listening".结尾用一句行动邀请（Just let me know…），不要用 Thanks for listening。

📘 Template and phrases模板与常用句

Strategy策略

  • Be considerate but firm, and respectful.语气：体谅但坚定（considerate but firm）。
  • Outline the problem, explain your decision, give reasons.说清问题 → 说出你的决定 → 给有力的理由。
  • Speak directly to the person.直接对那个人说话（Hi Mr. Kim, …）。

Tips提醒

  • Don't start by questioning the person directly. First "sorry to bother you", then the facts, and only then the decision.开头别直接质问。先 sorry to bother you，再说事实，最后才是决定。
  • Make the "decision" clear: I've decided to ... Don't just complain.「决定」要明确：I've decided to …，不要只抱怨。
  • Leave 5 seconds for an ending: "I hope you understand" sounds steadier.留 5 秒结尾：I hope you understand，听感更稳。

Template模板

Greet and say why you are calling称呼 + 说明来意Hi …, I'm calling about … I wanted to talk to you in person.
The problem问题是什么The problem is that … It has been happening for …
My decision and reasons我的决定 + 原因So I've decided to … because …
Soften and close给对方一个台阶 + 结束I hope you understand. I'm happy to … Let me know what you think.

Phrase bank句子库

  • I'm sorry to bother you, but … 不好意思打扰你，但……
    I'm sorry to bother you, but I have a problem.
  • I wanted to talk to you about … 我想和你谈谈……
    I wanted to talk to you about the noise.
  • The problem is that … 问题是……
    The problem is that I can't sleep.
  • I understand that …, but … 我理解……，但是……
    I understand that you are busy, but this is serious.
  • I've decided to … 我已经决定……
    I've decided to talk to the landlord.
  • I'm afraid I can't … 恐怕我没办法……
    I'm afraid I can't lend you the car.
  • I hope you understand. 希望你能理解。
    I hope you understand.
  • Would it be possible to …? 能不能……？
    Would it be possible to keep it down after ten?
  • I'd really appreciate it if … 如果……我会很感激
    I'd really appreciate it if you could help.
  • That's why I … 所以我才……
    That's why I decided to call you.
